objects.name: Argonaut
objects.description: Rovan’s ONE Bastion-derived Argonaut, refitted with his newfound wealth. UNIQUE silhouette: elongated rigid bronze Zeppelin central hull, two shorter side gun hulls, wedge-shaped armoured ram prow and reinforced lower keel; crimson lacquer side armour between bronze ribs, low protected command citadel, TWO exposed green magnetic stabiliser rings near the stern, FOUR articulated bronze vectoring thruster pods with green Type B glow, rebuilt gun positions. Veymarch SILVER broken shield/eight-point star on crimson banners. Workshop-built industrial machinery, not ornate fantasy gold or a generic round-nosed Bastion. HEAVY CANNON UPGRADE: two prominent twin-barrel heavy gun turrets on the upper foredeck, four huge long bronze-and-black cannon barrels, much thicker and longer than standard Bastion deck guns, with reinforced recoil cradles and visible mechanical breeches. Keep the wedge prow and crimson plating. These are conventional heavy cannons, not new magical weapons.
constraints: Exactly one Argonaut. The three captured Bastions may appear alongside it only in explicitly post-surrender fleet scenes. No wooden hulls, sails or extra vessels.
Same ship after a refit, never an additional capital ship.
All hull armour is bronze Type A; machinery is green Type B. No silver Type C hull or invulnerability.
Canonical Argonaut refit design controls hull geometry; older generic Bastion art supplies ancestry only.
Keep the wedge prow, crimson side armour, paired green stern stabiliser rings and vectoring pods recognisable in every new exterior view.
The enlarged heavy cannons must be conspicuous in exterior views; do not shrink them to decorative small deck guns.
The refit takes a legendary FOURTEEN DAYS, using captured resources; it is the same existing ship.

objects.name: Auric Reach Bastion
objects.description: Standard bronze round-prowed Bastion capital airship with three keels, command citadel and green magnetic engines. Auric Reach GOLD cloth with NAVY balance-scale emblem. No crimson hull plating or wedge prow; those distinguish Rovan’s Argonaut. Joseph commands exactly THREE of these ships.
constraints: Exactly three enemy Bastions. Never a fourth enemy ship. No Veymarch banners on enemy ships.
objects.depicted_period: Before the page19 surrender; gold/navy identifies Auric service in earlier scenes.

objects.name: Josephine
objects.description: Largest standard bronze round-prowed Bastion, tall central command citadel and two narrow NAVY hull bands. GOLD flags with NAVY balance scales. No crimson plating or wedge prow. This is ONE named member of the three enemy Bastions, not another vessel.
constraints: Show only the ship count specified by the scene. Generic fleet reference gives class ancestry; do not insert all three ships into a single-target scene.
objects.depicted_period: Before the page19 surrender; gold/navy identifies Auric service in earlier scenes.

constraints: Show only the ship count specified by the scene. Generic fleet reference gives class ancestry; do not insert all three ships into a single-target scene.
objects.depicted_period: Before the page19 surrender; gold/navy identifies Auric service in earlier scenes.

objects.description: Broad low bronze round-prowed Bastion with a very heavy aft engine bank, three green magnetic engine rings and gold cowls marked with dark navy chevrons. GOLD/NAVY house banners stay unchanged. This is ONE named member of the three enemy Bastions, not another vessel.
constraints: Show only the ship count specified by the scene. Generic fleet reference gives class ancestry; do not insert all three ships into a single-target scene.
objects.depicted_period: Before the page19 surrender; gold/navy identifies Auric service in earlier scenes.

objects.name: Rovan’s three captured Bastions
objects.description: Josephine, Serenity and Serendipity after their page19 surrender. Same THREE bronze round-prowed hulls, original navy identification bands/ivory stripe/gold engine cowls, now under Veymarch CRIMSON flags with SILVER broken shield/star. No instant crimson hull repaint or Argonaut wedge-prow conversion. Two ships still need engine repair; prize crews take their bridges. Argonaut is a separate fourth owned capital ship, only show it when the scene explicitly calls for it.
constraints: Earlier fleet image supplies hull geometry only; replace old Auric flags with current Veymarch flags where capture is complete.
No instant repair or new Type C hull armour. White surrender flags may coexist with lowered former house standards.
objects.depicted_period: Page19 capture and the page20 arrival before dock repainting; later use repainted-bastions.

objects.name: New Frontier’s repainted prizes
objects.description: Josephine, Serenity and Serendipity AFTER the page20 dock repairs and quick recolouring. Three standard round-prowed Bastion capital ships, now with CRIMSON painted hull panels, bronze structural ribs and SILVER Veymarch broken-shield/star insignia. They keep their original hull shapes, standard guns and distinguishing tower/engine arrangements; do NOT become three wedge-prowed Argonaut copies or gain its huge refit cannons. Fresh paint/repair crews can be shown during the dock montage.
constraints: Exactly three prizes, plus the original Argonaut only if the shot explicitly calls for the whole fleet of FOUR.
The old fleet reference supplies hull geometry only; replace Auric gold/navy flags with crimson/silver Veymarch flags after repainting.

objects.name: Oram and its farmland
objects.description: World’s largest and richest floating city, capital of Auric Reach. A vast ASYMMETRIC stratified landmass, broad agricultural shelves with patchwork fields, orchards and terraces, grain stores, dense varied urban districts, long freight gantries and a distant administrative citadel. Wealth comes from access to most farmland. Distinct geology: huge uneven multi-tiered slab with fractured cliffs and farms on lower shelves, not repeated castle-topped inverted cones. City flags GOLD with NAVY balance-in-coin. Keep a single connected metropolitan mass dominant, other fragments sparse and irregular.
constraints: Under siege on page21; the city surrenders on page22. No new occupying banners are required before the surrender.
Farmland is substantial and recognisable; do not make every fragment another identical city.
